

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Fire Monkey|kanji=丙申|romaji=hinoe saru|onyomi=heishin|p=bǐngshēn|w=ping-shen|mi=pʰiŋ²¹ ʂən|y=bing2 san1|j=bing2 san1|ci=pɪŋ ʂɐn|mc=pæŋ ʂin|oc-bs=praŋ ʂin}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Fire Monkey''' (丙申, ''hinoe saru''; onyomi ''heishin'') is the 33rd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 33rd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Wood Goat|ja|乙未}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Fire Rooster|af|Vuurhaan (astrologie)|cdo|Dĭng-iū|de|Feuer-Hahn|fr|Coq de feu|hak|Tên-yû|ja|丁酉|ko|정유 (간지)|nds|Füür-Hahn|vi|Đinh Dậu|za|Dingyoux|zh|丁酉|zh_min_nan|Teng-iú|zh_yue|丁酉|qid=Q201551}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丙'' is Yang Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''申'' (Monkey) is Yang Metal; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Fire Monkey (丙申)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): bǐngshēn
** Cantonese (Jyutping): bing3 san1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoe-saru
*** On'yomi: heishin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): byeongsin (병신)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Bính Thân

==Months of Yang Fire Monkey==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|lt=Kanoto (辛)}} and {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|lt=Hinoe (丙)}}), the month of {{ill|July|en|July|qid=Q121|lt=July}} is designated as the Heishin month ({{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}}). However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Beginning of Autumn}} until the day before {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=White Dew}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Fire Monkey==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日}} for Heishin is as follows.
=== Selected Day (選日) ===
Heishin day is the 4th day of {{ill|Tenitsu-shin|ja|天一天上|ja_comment=天一神|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
